{'text': 'tvOS 27.2 將於下週推出，為 Apple TV 4K 用戶帶來多項新功能，當中包括螢幕保護程式的升級。以下是新增功能介紹。', 'paragraph_context': 'tvOS 27.2 is coming next week, bringing several new features to Apple TV 4K users—including some screen saver upgrades. Here’s what’s new.'}

{'text': '#1：螢幕保護程式的隨機播放選項', 'paragraph_context': '#1: Shuffle option for screen savers'}

{'text': 'tvOS 提供多種出色的螢幕保護程式，分類包括 Aerials、Memories & Slideshows、Portraits 及 Snoopy。', 'paragraph_context': 'tvOS offers a variety of great screen savers across multiple categories, including Aerials, Memories & Slideshows, Portraits, and Snoopy.'}

{'text': '但以往你只可以從這些分類中揀選一個作為 Apple TV 的螢幕保護程式，因而錯過其他所有分類。', 'paragraph_context': 'But historically, you’ve had to choose just one of these categories for your Apple TV screen savers, thus missing out on all the others.'}

{'text': '在 tvOS 27.2 中，Apple 新增「隨機播放」（Shuffle）選項，可以全日輪流播放所有可用的螢幕保護程式，不受分類限制。', 'paragraph_context': 'In tvOS 27.2, Apple has a new ‘Shuffle’ option which will cycle through all available screen savers—regardless of category—throughout the day.'}

{'text': '我向來鍾情 Apple 精美的 Aerials 系列，但現在我可以一邊繼續欣賞 Aerials，一邊兼享其他螢幕保護程式分類，實在令人欣喜。', 'paragraph_context': 'I’ve always favored Apple’s beautiful selection of Aerials. But I love that now I can continue enjoying Aerials while also benefiting from the other screen saver categories too.'}

{'text': '#2：Apple TV 應用程式支援手語', 'paragraph_context': '#2: Apple TV app supports sign language'}

{'text': 'Apple TV 應用程式現在可讓觀眾在播放器控制選項中，開關支援手語的指定電影及節目。手稿由 Sigmund Judge 提供：', 'paragraph_context': 'For select movies and shows that support it, the Apple TV app now lets viewers toggle sign language options inside the player controls. Per Sigmund Judge:'}

{'text': '現已支援 ASL（美國手語）及 BSL（英國手語），進一步提升 Apple TV 應用程式內容的無障礙體驗。', 'paragraph_context': 'ASL (American Sign Language) and BSL (British Sign Language) are available, expanding accessibility for content in the Apple TV app.'}

{'text': '#3：從「照片」圖庫自訂螢幕保護程式', 'paragraph_context': '#3: Custom screen savers from Photos library'}

{'text': '如果你想自選「照片」中的螢幕保護程式內容，tvOS 27.2 提供了一個更便捷的新方式。', 'paragraph_context': 'If you want to curate Photos screen savers, tvOS 27.2 lets you do that in a new and convenient way.'}

{'text': '在設定 Memories & Slideshows 或 Portraits 分類下的螢幕保護程式時，現在可以從 iPhone 或 iPad 手動揀選要包含的內容。', 'paragraph_context': 'When setting up screen savers in the Memories & Slideshows or Portraits categories, you’re now able to manually select the content that’s included from your iPhone or iPad.'}

{'text': 'Keith B. 的熱門留言：', 'paragraph_context': 'Top comment by Keith B.'}

{'text': '決定再試一次新 Siri，但仍然無法播放「最近加入」之類的播放清單。無論我怎樣表達都不行。簡直離譜地差！明顯未準備好在 HomePod 或 ATV 上使用。', 'paragraph_context': 'Decided to give new Siri another try. Still can’t play a playlist, like Recently Added. No matter how I phrase it. It’s amazingly terrible! It’s definitely not ready for the HomePod or ATV.'}

{'text': '有了這項新功能，你可以用「照片」製作 Apple TV 螢幕保護程式，而毋須被迫向程式開放整個圖庫的存取權限。', 'paragraph_context': 'Thanks to this addition, you can enjoy Apple TV screen savers from Photos without being forced to let them access your full library.'}

{'text': '即將推出：Siri AI 及 HomePod 環繞音效', 'paragraph_context': 'Coming soon: Siri AI and HomePod surround sound'}

{'text': '全新 Apple TV 4K（第四代）將於 11 月 13 日開賣，並支援 Siri AI 及全新的四喇叭 HomePod 環繞音效配置。', 'paragraph_context': 'When the new Apple TV 4K (4th gen) arrives on November 13, it will include support for Siri AI and also a new four-speaker HomePod surround sound setup.'}

{'text': 'Apple TV 4K 第二代及第三代同樣會支援 Siri AI，但 tvOS 27.2 尚未提供此功能。', 'paragraph_context': 'Siri AI is coming to Apple TV 4K 2nd and 3rd generation too, but it’s not yet available in tvOS 27.2.'}

{'text': 'tvOS 27.2 目前已推出 RC（release candidate）版，預計將於下週正式發放給所有用戶。', 'paragraph_context': 'tvOS 27.2 is now available in RC (release candidate) and is expected to ship next week to all users.'}
